name: zz-auto-edit
description: 基于 HyperFrames 的自动剪辑 MVP：字幕解析、剪辑计划、HTML composition、预览与导出骨架。

scripts.render: npx hyperframes render -c compositions/current.html -o output/version-001.mp4 --fps 30 --quality standard
scripts.render:real: npm run build:real && npm run render && npm run assert:render
scripts.build:feedback: npm run build:real && npm run feedback:parse && npm run feedback:apply
scripts.render:feedback: npm run build:feedback && npx hyperframes render -c compositions/current.html -o output/version-002.mp4 --fps 30 --quality standard && npm run assert:feedback-render
